text: おんなのこに　イイ　とこ　みせようと　こんな　とこ　まで　きちゃった

structure.jp: おんなのこに　イイ　とこ　みせようと
structure.en: trying to show my good side to a girl

structure.jp: こんな　とこ　まで　きちゃった
structure.en: I ended up coming all the way to a place like this

patterns.name: 〜ようと
patterns.explanation: The よう ending means 'I'll do it', and と after it means 'with that in mind', so together they say what you were trying to do. みせようと = 'meaning to show'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing ended up happening, often with regret; ちゃった is its casual short form. きちゃった = 'I went and came'.

patterns.name: 〜まで
patterns.span: こんな　とこ　まで
patterns.explanation: まで means 'as far as', and here stresses how far he went. こんな　とこ　まで = 'all the way to a place like this'.
